source_window.resource_title: 6 September 2026 Ashford Borough Council GML download inventory
source_window.license: Open Government Licence (OGL), subject to HM Land Registry conditions of use

field_evidence.publication_version: HM Land Registry's official public download page states that this Local land charges spatial data (INSPIRE) release was published on 6 September 2026 and remains accessible until the files are updated.
field_evidence.ashford_file_listing: The official download inventory explicitly lists Ashford Borough Council with a downloadable GML file.
field_evidence.dataset_scope: The dataset contains polygons showing the indicative extent and position of local land charges in England and Wales, organised by local authority.
field_evidence.format: The Ashford distribution is supplied as GML and HM Land Registry states that GIS software is needed to view the downloaded polygons.
field_evidence.semantic_limit: A local land charge polygon represents the extent/position of a charge, not a registered-title/cadastral parcel boundary.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: This Ashford GML inventory is source-area evidence only. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted from a local-land-charge polygon inventory, and any spatial binding remains local OpenCode work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. An unused official HM Land Registry Local land charges spatial data (INSPIRE) window lists Ashford Borough Council with a downloadable GML polygon file, but those polygons represent the indicative extent/position of local land charges rather than registered-title/cadastral parcels. This is source-area evidence only and is not parcel progress. Local OpenCode must bind the exact target registered-title/title-boundary polygon or another authoritative canonical parcel geometry; after canonical bbox is bound, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from target-specific HM Land Registry INSPIRE WMS GetFeatureInfo transport attempts to the separate HM Land Registry Local Land Charges spatial-data distribution. The official public/no-login page exposes an Ashford Borough Council GML download inventory, but the dataset semantics are local-land-charge extents, not cadastral/title parcel extents. Accordingly no target parcel ID, canonical parcel geometry or bbox is asserted, source-area evidence is not counted as parcel progress, and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
